description: This file defines a CKEditor 5 plugin class 'DrupalMediaCaptionEditing' that manages the conversion and editing of media captions within Drupal media elements, including upcasting from view to model, downcasting from model to view and data, and handling caption state saving/restoring.

classes.name: DrupalMediaCaptionEditing
classes.description: A CKEditor 5 plugin class that handles caption conversion, editing, and state management for Drupal media elements.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the plugin instance, setting up a WeakMap for saved captions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up schema, commands, and conversion pipelines for caption handling.

methods.name: _setupConversion
methods.description: Configures upcast, downcast, and view-to-model conversion for captions.

methods.name: _getSavedCaption
methods.description: Retrieves a saved caption for a given media element from internal storage.

methods.name: _saveCaption
methods.description: Saves a caption for a media element to enable future restoration.
